characters.continuity: Fantastic Four (Unreleased/Expected Cinematic Universe) / Marvel Comics adaptations
characters.summary: Human Torch manipulates intense thermal energy and plasma, capable of flight and projecting devastating fire blasts. While not technically in the Marvel Cinematic Universe proper as of early phases, comic and cross-over scaling establishes his standard baseline combat style.
weaknesses: Dowsing by high-volume water or specialized extinguishing foams
limitations: Flame output diminishes in oxygen-deprived environments.

sources.supports: General character powers, fire manipulation, and flight capabilities.

feats.claim: Engulfed entire body in flame and flew at high speeds.

campaignTags.claim: Can engulf entire body in fire and project intense flames.
Manipulates ambient heat and directs plasma blasts.
Flies through self-propulsion via concentrated thermal energy.

unknowns: Exact MCU timeline integration details prior to official studio release.

characters.summary: Ikaris is an immortal Eternal possessing vast cosmic energy manipulation, supersonic flight, and intense heat beams projected from his eyes. He relies heavily on direct aerial assault and formidable physical resilience.

mechanisms: Immense durability against physical and energy strikes

weaknesses: Vulnerable to specialized cosmic suppression or confinement by fellow Eternals
limitations: Energy output draws upon internal cosmic reserve, though rarely depleted in standard combat.

sources.supports: Ikaris abilities including flight, cosmic eye beams, and Eternal physiology.

feats.claim: Flew into the sun after experiencing intense emotional conflict.

notableResults.note: Fought against various fellow Eternals during ideological splits.

campaignTags.claim: Flies at supersonic speeds using inherent cosmic energy.
Projects concentrated cosmic energy beams from eyes.

unknowns: Full upper limits of durability against localized singularity weapons.

characters.continuity: Fantastic Four (Unreleased/Expected Cinematic Universe) / Marvel Comics adaptations
characters.summary: Invisible Woman uses psychokinesis to render herself and others completely invisible, while generating resilient force fields for defense and offensive crushing blows. She combines stealth tactics with formidable kinetic shields.

mechanisms: Complete visual camouflage via light bending

weaknesses: Concentration required to maintain complex force fields under heavy assault.
limitations: Maintained shields can be strained by continuous high-output kinetic or energy pounding.

sources.supports: Invisibility and psychokinetic force field generation.

feats.claim: Created load-bearing force fields capable of withstanding immense weight and pressure.

campaignTags.claim: Can bend light waves to render herself and others completely invisible.
Utilizes absolute invisibility for covert reconnaissance and surprise strikes.
Manipulates psychokinetic energy to form shields and lift objects.

characters.summary: Iron Fist channels his chi into his hand to deliver devastating melee strikes and enhance his physical conditioning. He fights primarily as a martial artist utilizing hand-to-hand combat bolstered by mystical energy.
weaknesses: Emotional turmoil can disrupt chi concentration and weaken his abilities.
limitations: Chi glowing fist requires brief recovery or deep focus after heavy usage.

sources.supports: Chi channeling, martial arts expertise, and physical enhancement.

feats.claim: Smashed open reinforced steel doors with a single chi-empowered fist strike.

campaignTags.claim: Can focus chi to accelerate physical healing.
Channels mystical chi originating from K'un-Lun.

unknowns: Full extent of chi projection range beyond close quarters.

characters.continuity: Marvel Cinematic Universe (Base Armor / Mark III-VII era)
characters.summary: Iron Man utilizes powered armor equipped with repulsor rays, unibeam chest projectors, and onboard tactical artificial intelligence. He engages opponents at range with energy blasts while maintaining high maneuverability via flight thrusters.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to severe electromagnetic pulses and internal system hacking if security is breached.
limitations: Energy weapons draw directly from onboard arc reactor power reserves.

sources.supports: Mark III armor capabilities, repulsors, and flight systems.

feats.claim: Tanked direct tank shell fire with minor armor structural damage.

notableResults.note: Defeated Stane by overloading the Stark Industries arc reactor.

campaignTags.claim: Wears advanced high-tech armored suits providing immense durability and weaponry.
Uses boot and glove repulsor jets for controlled flight.
Equipped with onboard missiles, flares, and scanning lasers.
Designs and builds advanced mechanical armor systems and AI.

unknowns: Exact power output thresholds against heavy cosmic energy assaults.

characters.continuity: Marvel Comics (Bleeding Edge armor era / applicable high-end MCU extrapolations)
characters.summary: Bleeding Edge Iron Man stores his armor entirely within his own biological system as nanomachines, allowing instantaneous deployment, shape-shifting weapon creation, and self-repairing capabilities.
weaknesses: Susceptible to targeted magnetic field manipulation capable of scattering liquid nanites.
characters.formDifferences: Replaces mechanical modular parts with endosymbiotic/nanotech integration stored inside the user's body, granting instant mental summons and morphic weapon generation.

sources.supports: Bleeding Edge nanotech armor details and morphological weapon generation.

unknowns: Total nanite mass limit before requiring external replenishment.

characters.continuity: Marvel Comics (e.g. Tony Stark: Iron Man series)
characters.summary: Godbuster Iron Man operates within a virtual reality-engineered armor frame translated into physical reality, packing immense skyscraper-scale power designed to rival celestial or god-like entities.
weaknesses: Extreme energy draw and heavy strain on operating systems.
characters.formDifferences: Drastically increases physical size and energy output far beyond standard armor tiers, utilizing virtual reality architecture for maximum efficiency.

sources.supports: Godbuster armor specifications and extreme power metrics.

unknowns: Long-term operational endurance without system burnout.

characters.summary: Model Prime Iron Man employs advanced smart-nanotech capable of transforming into any specialized armor configuration—including stealth, heavy artillery, or heavy shielding—instantly on command.
weaknesses: Complex computational demands can be overloaded by sophisticated techno-organic viruses.
characters.formDifferences: Utilizes a single foundational suit of smart-materials that morphs into various mission-specific configurations rather than requiring separate suits.

sources.supports: Model Prime modular multi-functional armor properties.

unknowns: Resistance limits against high-level reality manipulation.

characters.summary: The Nanotech Mark L stores compactly on Tony Stark's chest housing and deploys across his body via thought command, allowing versatile weapon generation such as energy blades, shields, and repulsor cannons on the fly.

mechanisms: Fluid nanomaterial redistribution to damaged zones

weaknesses: Finite nanite stock; if too many particles are lost or used for massive shields, armor integrity drops.
limitations: Total structural integrity degrades under sustained heavy physical trauma from immensely strong opponents.
characters.formDifferences: Replaces physical mechanical pieces with liquid nanites stored in a central chest node, enabling instant formation and morphic weaponry.

sources.supports: Mark L nanotech suit features, deployment, and usage against Thanos.

feats.claim: Drew a drop of blood from Thanos on Titan using condensed nanotech blade strikes.

notableResults.note: Engaged in single combat on Titan, ultimately overpowered and impaled.

campaignTags.claim: Advanced nanotech armor providing complete body coverage and integrated weaponry.
Features integrated repulsor thrusters for rapid flight.
Forms shields, energy blades, and cannons instantly from stored nanites.
Designed and built by Tony Stark.

unknowns: Maximum possible nanite regeneration rate under continuous plasma fire.

characters.summary: Superior Iron Man utilizes an endosymbiotic liquid-metal armor controlled directly by telepathic link, combining ruthless tactical cunning with fluid nano-mesh capabilities to manipulate or subjugate opponents.
weaknesses: Psychological arrogance can lead to underestimating opponents.
characters.formDifferences: Armor is made of liquid-metal psionically bonded to the user's nervous system, allowing it to flow freely and infect or encase targets.

sources.supports: Endosymbiotic armor properties and telepathic fluid-metal control.
